== QuartetsMIREX 2026 test set ==

The "Undisclosed Evaluation Set" mentioned in the challenge consists of 8 string quartets score taken from [kern.ccarh.org](https://kern.ccarh.org) 
and processed like the original Quartets dataset to produce 373 kern excerpts.
These quartets are from composers not represented in the original dataset: Schubert, Brahms, and Mendelssohn.
